Package com.softgapx.appypay.spring

Class AppyPayProperties

java.lang.Object
com.softgapx.appypay.spring.AppyPayProperties
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix="appypay") public class AppyPayProperties extends Object
Propriedades de configuração da AppyPay, lidas de application.properties ou application.yml sob o prefixo appypay. 

 appypay:
   environment: sandbox
   client-id: ${APPYPAY_CLIENT_ID}
   client-secret: ${APPYPAY_CLIENT_SECRET}
   payment-method-gpo: ${APPYPAY_PAYMENT_METHOD_GPO}
   payment-method-ref: ${APPYPAY_PAYMENT_METHOD_REF}
